mapper.insert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO chat_sessions (session_id, title, message_count, created_at, last_active) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{title}, 0, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT s.session_id, CASE WHEN s.title IS NULL OR s.title = '' OR s.title = '新对话' THEN (SELECT m.content FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.role = 'user' ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT 1) ELSE s.title END AS title, s.message_count, s.created_at, s.last_active FROM chat_sessions s ORDER BY s.last_active DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (session_id, message_id, role, content, skill_name, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{skillName}, #{now})
